environment.description: Same binary deployed on AWS Graviton3 (c7g.xlarge) with Amazon Linux 2023, but the PostgreSQL 15 connection uses IAM database authentication mapped to a per-tenant database role via STS session tags. The RLS policy references current_setting('app.current_tenant') which is set by a pg_hba.conf clientcert=verify-full entry combined with a connection_init hook that extracts tenant from the client certificate CN and calls SET app.current_tenant. The database role has NOBYPASSRLS and is not a superuser. Additionally, the kernel is compiled with CONFIG_INIT_ON_FREE_PAGES=y and the allocator uses scudo (hardened) via LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib64/libscudo.so with quarantine_size_kb=4096, which zeros freed memory and quarantines freed chunks preventing immediate reuse. The MQTT listener runs behind an NLB with a security group restricting DISCONNECT packet sources to the device gateway subnet (10.0.1.0/24) only, and device gateway validates session tokens before forwarding DISCONNECT.

config.pg_auth: IAM database auth with STS session tags
config.mqtt_network: NLB with SG restricting to 10.0.1.0/24 device gateway
config.aslr: enabled with full 48-bit VA on aarch64
